changes.planned: One fictional squat rectangular perfume bottle of translucent smoky obsidian glass with wider shoulders and a front-left diagonal facet.
changes.observed: One centered squat rectangular perfume bottle remains, made from dark translucent smoky glass with broad shoulders and a pronounced asymmetric front-right facet; no label is present.

changes.planned: Large soft white source camera-left, narrow amber underlight, dense glass and viscous black liquid.
changes.observed: A large cool soft source creates broad white glass and metal reflections from camera-left, while a narrow amber underlight glows through the bottle base and liquid. The glass reads dense and transparent, the collar polished metal, the cap glossy black, and the liquid viscous.

changes.planned: Bottle rises two centimeters; clip ends with one petal crossing the front-right edge and an exterior droplet descending on the left face.
changes.observed: The bottle rises out of the liquid and ends visibly hovering above the surface. The collar elements retain unresolved rotational displacement, the exterior droplet remains suspended in a downward path, expanding ripples remain below, and the cap stays closed.

changes.planned: Bottle remains centered in shallow black liquid while camera arcs front-left toward center and ring rotates clockwise.
changes.observed: The bottle ends centered in a near-frontal view above a low black-liquid horizon. The dominant silver petal crosses the collar from center toward upper-right, and the left face and front-right facet remain readable.

changes.planned: The sealed product emerges and accumulates an unresolved moving ring and droplet state.
changes.observed: The sealed bottle has emerged and is still hovering with the collar rotation, exterior droplet, and surface ripples unresolved. The cap has not opened.

changes.planned: Asymmetrical brushed-silver collar, low black stone cap, one internal amber droplet, one rotating silver petal ring, no label.
changes.observed: The bottle has a glossy rounded black cap and overlapping curved silver collar elements. A large amber droplet hangs on the exterior upper-left face. A separate internal droplet is not clearly discernible in the accepted final frame.
